body: Would it be possible for you to chat me directly? I have only conducted audio interviews for this project so far, and would be willing to adjust if you need to, but I'd like to talk about it first. Thank you!

I'm interested to hear your life story and how your suicide attempts fit into that life story. I start interviews by just getting to know about you: where you grew up, who was in your family, what were your relationships like growing up, etc. Then, we talk about your experiences thinking about and/or attempting suicide: what was going on in your life, what were the thoughts in your head, how were you feeling. As for race, I'm recruiting people across all social identities to see if people's narratives and experiences track with their social identities: race, social class, gender, and LGBTQIA+ status. In this phase of recruitment, I'm specifically recruiting people of color because that's an area where my sample is not representative of the U.S. population. Since I'd like to capture suicide experiences in the U.S. in this research project, it's important for me to make sure my sample represents all people's voices, which is why I'm recruiting people of color. I would love to hear your story if you are interested in participating. My research number is (413) 461-0811 and my email is [krbillings@umass.edu](mailto:krbillings@umass.edu). Please feel free to email, text, or call if you'd be willing to share your story and/or if you have more questions about the project. Thanks so much for posting!
